title: Anna and Her Magazines
text:
Many people enjoy reading magazines. A magazine has short articles about music, sports, travel and science. Anna buys a magazine about cooking every month. She likes the recipes and the photos. Her friend Tom reads a magazine about cars.

Last week, Anna's cooking magazine had an article about bees. The article said that bees are important for flowers and fruit. It also said that many bees are dying. Anna read it twice and then she told her friends about it.

questions.text: What does Anna buy every month?
What did the article say about bees?
options: Bees are important for flowers and fruit
Bees live only in big cities

questions.text: What can we infer about Anna?
options: She is interested in food and nature
She does not like to read
She works in a car factory

questions.text: Why did Anna tell her friends about the article?
options: She thought the information was important
She wanted to sell them a magazine
She was angry about the bees
She did not understand the article

vocabulary.definition: a regular publication with articles, photos and stories
a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine
instructions for cooking a particular dish

paragraph_translations: Багато людей люблять читати журнали. Журнал має короткі статті про музику, спорт, подорожі та науку. Анна щомісяця купує журнал про кулінарію. Їй подобаються рецепти та фотографії. Її друг Том читає журнал про автомобілі.

Минулого тижня в кулінарному журналі Анни була стаття про бджіл. У статті говорилося, що бджоли важливі для квітів і фруктів. Там також говорилося, що багато бджіл гине. Анна прочитала її двічі, а потім розповіла про неї друзям.
